bio.text: Ron Weinberg is a Republican who represents District 51 (Larimer County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where he took office on January 9, 2023, according to Ballotpedia.
The Colorado General Assembly lists his occupation as founder and owner of 365 IT – Technology Solutions, and Ballotpedia says his professional experience includes work in information technology.
